event.title: Hijackers
event.text:
A dark GATOS hull drops out of a jump right on top of your squad, its emblem scorched black. Its captain doesn't bother with a greeting.
"Nice ships. We'll be taking one."

event.title: The Toll
event.text: Two ships with mismatched panels and stolen weapons block the only clean jump lane out of the cluster. "Toll's due," their captain announces. "Pay up and fly on, or don't, and we'll take it off your wrecks."

outcome.text: You transfer the Mawjig. They let you pass with a mocking salute.
"Your funeral," the captain says, and their weapons come online.

choice.text: Lock their bridge down and let the doors do the talking.

outcome.text: You broadcast your door and boarding defences in detail. The pirates mutter among themselves and decide you aren't worth the trouble.
They aren't impressed.

event.title: A Call for Help
event.text: A GATOS freighter is broadcasting a distress call: engines out, life support failing, children aboard. Your sensors read the freighter's hold as full of armed crew.

choice.text: Answer the call anyway, ready for a fight.

outcome.text: The "freighter" powers up weapons the moment you come in range.
As you charge your drives, the distress call cuts off and a very different voice swears at you over an open channel.

event.title: Inspection
event.text: A GATOS patrol cutter hails you, its paint gone dark and its emblem replaced with something meaner. "Checkpoint. Outsiders and their friends pay for passage now. You've got outsider stink all over you."

outcome.text: They take the Mawjig and wave you through with a sneer.
A long silence. "Not anymore you're not." They open fire.
The captain hesitates, then mutters something about the colony ship and lets you through. "Go on. Before I change my mind."

event.title: Mecha Territory
event.text: A pair of black Mecha frames slides out of the dark, purple lights pulsing along their blades. "This is Mecha territory," says a voice that sounds almost childishly pleased with itself. "You're trespassing. That makes your ship ours."

choice.text: Offer them Mawjig to look the other way.

outcome.text: They consider it. "Fine. Profit is profit." The frames peel away.
"Why take some when we can take all of it?"

choice.text: Have {crew} answer them in their own words.

outcome.text: {crew} answers in a stream of clipped Mecha code. There's a pause, then a burst of what might be laughter. "A HalfMech crewing a scout? Go on, then. Bring us something good next time."

event.title: Get Out
event.text: A lone Mecha frame shadows your squad, keeping its distance. "You are outnumbering us," it admits, sounding sulky. "Leave our territory. Now. Or we'll call the others."

outcome.text: The frame follows you to the edge of the cluster and then stops, watching you go.

choice.text: Attack it before it calls anyone.

event.title: Raiders
event.text: Mecha frames with mismatched plates and half their lights broken come at you in formation. The doomed Mecha haven't turned refugee. They've turned raider.

event.title: Coming Through
event.text: A small, pearly Tentauri ship is heading straight through your formation. Two soft voices speak at once. "Please move. We are going through. We would rather not hurt anyone."

choice.text: Move aside and let them pass.

outcome.text: The Tentauri ship glides between your ships. As it passes, it sends a short, polite pulse of thanks.

choice.text: Hold formation. Make them go around.

outcome.text: "Then we are sorry," the voices say, and shields flare to life.
{crew} drifts to the comm and talks with the strangers for a long time, in voices too soft to follow. When it's over, the Tentauri pass, and leave a small gift of Mawjig in your path.

event.title: Turn Back
event.text: A winged Azurethea ship spreads between you and the cluster's inner worlds. "We have had enough of ships like yours," its captain says. "Turn back. We don't want to fight, but we will."

outcome.text: You pull away. The Azurethea ship watches you go, wings spread, until you jump.
{crew} speaks with them softly. The ship folds its wings, and its captain sends you a little of their Mawjig. "For anyone who still travels with one of us."

event.title: Preservation
event.text:
A Senti relay ship turns its weapons toward you as you arrive.
"We, The Senti-, are preserving everything we can before this cluster is lost. We will preserve your records and your biological data. Lower your shields. This will not take long."

choice.text: Transmit your records and let them scan your crew.

outcome.text: The ship takes your records, then scans every member of your crew down to the cell. When it is finished, it powers down its weapons without another word. You leave as quickly as your drives allow.
"We, The Senti-, will preserve what is left of you."

event.title: A Picket Line
event.text: A Senti picket ship sweeps your squad with sensors so strong your consoles flicker. "We, The Senti-, are recording a hostile intrusion." It does not wait for you to argue.

event.title: The Hunt
event.text: Howling floods every channel as a patched-together Lykario ship swings around to face you. "Good hunting, little scouts! Run if you want. It's more fun when you run."

choice.text: Offer to share the hunt instead.

outcome.text: {crew} howls back. The Lykario fall silent, then laugh, and the raider peels off with an invitation to hunt together "after all this is over."

event.title: Everything Is Fine
event.text: A Lykario ship hails you, its captain grinning. "Collapse? What collapse? We're hunting, same as always. You look like good sport."

choice.text: Bribe them to hunt someone else.

outcome.text: "Ha! Fair enough." They take the Mawjig and go off howling.
"Keep it. We'll take it off you anyway."

event.title: Something Alive
event.text: A swollen, lopsided shape detaches itself from a field of overgrown wreckage. It's a ship, and it's alive. It turns toward you slowly, like something waking up hungry.

choice.text: Open fire before it gets closer.
Jettison some matter for it and back away.

outcome.text: The living ship drifts to the cloud of matter you dumped and folds around it. It doesn't follow you.
It ignores the offering and keeps coming.

event.title: Intercept
event.text: Your sensors light up: ships on an intercept course, weapons hot. They don't answer your hails.

event.title: Desperate
event.text: "Give us your ships!" The voice on the channel is ragged. "We just need to get away from it, you understand? We need your ships!" Their weapons are already charging.
